claims: John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) is the primary airport in central Ohio.
John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) is located 6 miles from downtown Columbus.
John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) is undergoing a $2 billion expansion.
A new terminal at John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) is scheduled to open in 2029.
John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) features three concourses (A, B, C).
John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) has 34 gates.
John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) has a parking garage with 4,030 spaces.
The walking lot at 4370 International Gateway closes permanently on May 4, 2026.
Major carriers at John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) include Southwest, Delta, American, United, Air Canada, Alaska, Allegiant, Frontier, Spirit, and others.
CMH Next is a $2 billion multi-year project currently underway at John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH).
CMH Next is to build a new 1-million-square-foot terminal at John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH).
CMH Next is to build a new parking garage at John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH).
The new terminal at John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) is expected by 2029.
The walking lot closes to make way for a new public safety building at John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH).
The new public safety building is part of the CMH Next expansion.
